mainEntity.name: How long does framing for a remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small framing changes can move quickly, but remodel framing often takes longer than people expect because existing walls, hidden damage, and permit or inspection timing can slow things down. A simple non-structural change may take days, while larger remodel framing can take one to several weeks depending on scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small framing jobs may take a few days, while larger remodels can take one to several weeks. Timing depends on structural complexity, hidden issues, and inspection or permit scheduling.
